name: ai.usepromise/promise
title: Promise
description: Evidence-backed follow-through memory for what you owe, await, and need to remember.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.safetyContract: Promise MCP exposes derived Promise memory, not raw mailbox access. MCP v1 does not send email.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authFlow: Unauthenticated protected tools return a Promise signup/authorization URL. Promise returns a short-lived one-time code; agents exchange it at /api/mcp/token for a scoped pmcp_ bearer token.
